title: File:(1)Jamison Valley 032.jpg
claims: The image shows a broad view of the Jamison Valley from Echo Point: layered forested ridges, sandstone cliff walls catching warm light and a blue sky with scattered cloud.

The Commons file identifies Jamison Valley seen from Echo Point in the Blue Mountains National Park; it contains no UTA race context. The official UTA100 course description names Narrow Neck, Ironpot Ridge, Leura Forest, Wentworth Falls, Kedumba Pass and Furber Steps, but this photograph is a general valley view, not those points or the race track.
The author is Sardaka; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the original is 6,535 x 4,612 pixels and 18.4 MB; the photograph was taken on 2017-07-09; the file has no camera coordinates.
The route page uses a 960 x 678 thumbnail of 168,730 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source; attribution is required and adaptations must be shared alike.
